Setup & Scripts
**Prerequisites:** - Node.js >= 22.13.0 (required by pdfjs-dist v6) - Bun (this repo uses `bun@1.3.1`) **Setup:** ```bash git clone https://github.com/SylphxAI/pdf-reader-mcp.git cd pdf-reader-mcp bun install && bun run build ``` **Scripts:** ```bash bun run build # Build with bunup bun test # Run 173 tests bun run test:cov # Coverage (94%+) bun run check # Lint + format bun run check:fix # Auto-fix bun run benchmark # Performance tests ``` **Quality:** - ✅ 173 tests - ✅ 94%+ coverage - ✅ 98%+ function coverage - ✅ Zero lint errors - ✅ Strict TypeScript
Contributing
**Quick Start:** 1. Fork repository 2. Create branch: `git checkout -b feature/awesome` 3. Make changes: `bun test` 4. Format: `bun run check:fix` 5. Commit: Use [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) 6. Open PR **Commit Format:** ``` feat(images): add WebP support fix(paths): handle UNC paths docs(readme): update examples ``` See [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md)
